characterizations.result_summary: Measured Tg of Amylopectin as 105 °C and Tm as 166 °C, findings confirmed by IGC.

evidence.source_sentence: Amylopectin was thermally characterized by the melting point determination of DSC and TGA methods.
The temperature of 166 °C was later identified to be the   $T_{m}$  and 105 °C to be the   $T_{g}$  of Amylopectin. IGC has confirmed the findings of the DSC technique.

characterizations.result_summary: Amylopectin decomposed at ~343 °C with ~80% weight loss, showed transition at ~105 °C with 6% weight loss and transition at ~166 °C with no measurable weight loss.

evidence.source_sentence: Amylopectin was thermally characterized by the melting point determination of DSC and TGA methods.

The polymer was decomposed at approximately 343 °C with approximately 80% weight loss. The polymer also showed two transitions at approximately 105 °C, accompanied by 6% weight loss and at approximately 166 °C with no measurable weight loss.
